dogecoin.text: Doginal Bat, a 3D dogecoin inscription of a golden bat, is now available on Doggy Market! The 3D file (~1 MB .glb) is stored directly on the dogecoin blockchain, and it is designed to be used as a sword weapon in @Nifty_Island. 420 supply, 6.9 DOGE price. Much wow, doge to Mars! https://t.co/0UGF9bxHfp
